055    public static String getModififerKML(String id,
056            String name,
057            String description,
058            String symbolCode,
059            String controlPoints,
060            Double scale,
061            String bbox,
062            SparseArray symbolModifiers,
063            SparseArray symbolAttributes,
064            int format, int symStd) {
065        String output = "";
066        List<String> placemarks = new LinkedList<String>();
067
068        try {
069            double maxAlt = 0;
070            double minAlt = 0;
071
072            output = RenderSymbol(id, name, description, symbolCode, controlPoints, scale, bbox, symbolModifiers, symbolAttributes, format, symStd);
073            int pmiStart = output.indexOf("<Placemark");
074            int pmiEnd = 0;
075            int curr = 0;
076            int count = 0;
077            String tempPlacemark = "";
078            while (pmiStart > 0) {
079                if (count > 0) {
080                    pmiEnd = output.indexOf("</Placemark>", pmiStart) + 12;
081                    tempPlacemark = output.substring(pmiStart, pmiEnd);
082
083                    if (tempPlacemark.contains("<Point>")) {
084                        placemarks.add(output.substring(pmiStart, pmiEnd));
085                    }
086                    //System.out.println(placemarks.get(count));
087                    //end, check for more
088                    pmiStart = output.indexOf("<Placemark", pmiEnd - 2);
089                }
090                count++;
091            }
092            java.lang.StringBuilder sb = new java.lang.StringBuilder();
093            for (String pm : placemarks) {
094                sb.append(pm);
095            }
096            return sb.toString();
097        } catch (Exception exc) {
098
099        }
100
101        return output;
102    }

104    /**
105     * GE has the unusual distinction of being an application with coordinates
106     * outside its own extents. It appears to only be a problem when lines cross
107     * the IDL
108     *
109     * @param pts2d the client points
110     */
111    public static void NormalizeGECoordsToGEExtents(double leftLongitude,
112            double rightLongitude,
113            ArrayList<Point2D> pts2d) {
114        try {
115            int j = 0;
116            double x = 0, y = 0;
117            Point2D pt2d = null;
118            int n = pts2d.size();
119            //for (j = 0; j < pts2d.size(); j++) 
120            for (j = 0; j < n; j++) {
121                pt2d = pts2d.get(j);
122                x = pt2d.getX();
123                y = pt2d.getY();
124                while (x < leftLongitude) {
125                    x += 360;
126                }
127                while (x > rightLongitude) {
128                    x -= 360;
129                }
130
131                pt2d = new Point2D.Double(x, y);
132                pts2d.set(j, pt2d);
133            }
134        } catch (Exception exc) {
135        }
136    }
137
138    /**
139     * GE recognizes coordinates in the range of -180 to +180
140     *
141     * @param pt2d
142     * @return
143     */
144    private static Point2D NormalizeCoordToGECoord(Point2D pt2d) {
145        Point2D ptGeo = null;
146        try {
147            double x = pt2d.getX(), y = pt2d.getY();
148            while (x < -180) {
149                x += 360;
150            }
151            while (x > 180) {
152                x -= 360;
153            }
154
155            ptGeo = new Point2D.Double(x, y);
156        } catch (Exception exc) {
157        }
158        return ptGeo;
159    }

161    /**
162     * We have to ensure the bounding rectangle at least includes the symbol or
163     * there are problems rendering, especially when the symbol crosses the IDL
164     *
165     * @param controlPoints the client symbol anchor points
166     * @param bbox the original bounding box
167     * @return the modified bounding box
168     */
169    private static String getBoundingRectangle(String controlPoints,
170            String bbox) {
171        String bbox2 = "";
172        try {
173            //first get the minimum bounding rect for the geo coords
174            Double left = 0.0;
175            Double right = 0.0;
176            Double top = 0.0;
177            Double bottom = 0.0;
178
179            String[] coordinates = controlPoints.split(" ");
180            int len = coordinates.length;
181            int i = 0;
182            left = Double.MAX_VALUE;
183            right = -Double.MAX_VALUE;
184            top = -Double.MAX_VALUE;
185            bottom = Double.MAX_VALUE;
186            for (i = 0; i < len; i++) {
187                String[] coordPair = coordinates[i].split(",");
188                Double latitude = Double.valueOf(coordPair[1].trim());
189                Double longitude = Double.valueOf(coordPair[0].trim());
190                if (longitude < left) {
191                    left = longitude;
192                }
193                if (longitude > right) {
194                    right = longitude;
195                }
196                if (latitude > top) {
197                    top = latitude;
198                }
199                if (latitude < bottom) {
200                    bottom = latitude;
201                }
202            }
203            bbox2 = left.toString() + "," + bottom.toString() + "," + right.toString() + "," + top.toString();
204        } catch (Exception ex) {
205            System.out.println("Failed to create bounding rectangle in MultiPointHandler.getBoundingRect");
206        }
207        return bbox2;
208    }

210    /**
211     * need to use the symbol to get the upper left control point in order to
212     * produce a valid PointConverter
213     *
214     * @param geoCoords
215     * @return
216     */
217    private static Point2D getControlPoint(ArrayList<Point2D> geoCoords) {
218        Point2D pt2d = null;
219        try {
220            double left = Double.MAX_VALUE;
221            double right = -Double.MAX_VALUE;
222            double top = -Double.MAX_VALUE;
223            double bottom = Double.MAX_VALUE;
224            Point2D ptTemp = null;
225            int n = geoCoords.size();
226            //for (int j = 0; j < geoCoords.size(); j++) 
227            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
228                ptTemp = geoCoords.get(j);
229                if (ptTemp.getX() < left) {
230                    left = ptTemp.getX();
231                }
232                if (ptTemp.getX() > right) {
233                    right = ptTemp.getX();
234                }
235                if (ptTemp.getY() > top) {
236                    top = ptTemp.getY();
237                }
238                if (ptTemp.getY() < bottom) {
239                    bottom = ptTemp.getY();
240                }
241            }
242            pt2d = new Point2D.Double(left, top);
243        } catch (Exception ex) {
244            System.out.println("Failed to create control point in MultiPointHandler.getControlPoint");
245        }
246        return pt2d;
247    }

249    /**
250     * Assumes a reference in which the north pole is on top.
251     *
252     * @param geoCoords the geographic coordinates
253     * @return the upper left corner of the MBR containing the geographic
254     * coordinates
255     */
256    private static Point2D getGeoUL(ArrayList<Point2D> geoCoords) {
257        Point2D ptGeo = null;
258        try {
259            int j = 0;
260            Point2D pt = null;
261            double left = geoCoords.get(0).getX();
262            double top = geoCoords.get(0).getY();
263            double right = geoCoords.get(0).getX();
264            double bottom = geoCoords.get(0).getY();
265            int n = geoCoords.size();
266            //for (j = 1; j < geoCoords.size(); j++) 
267            for (j = 1; j < n; j++) {
268                pt = geoCoords.get(j);
269                if (pt.getX() < left) {
270                    left = pt.getX();
271                }
272                if (pt.getX() > right) {
273                    right = pt.getX();
274                }
275                if (pt.getY() > top) {
276                    top = pt.getY();
277                }
278                if (pt.getY() < bottom) {
279                    bottom = pt.getY();
280                }
281            }
282            //if geoCoords crosses the IDL
283            if (right - left > 180) {
284                //There must be at least one x value on either side of +/-180. Also, there is at least
285                //one positive value to the left of +/-180 and negative x value to the right of +/-180.
286                //We are using the orientation with the north pole on top so we can keep
287                //the existing value for top. Then the left value will be the least positive x value
288                //left = geoCoords.get(0).getX();
289                left = 180;
290                //for (j = 1; j < geoCoords.size(); j++) 
291                n = geoCoords.size();
292                for (j = 0; j < n; j++) {
293                    pt = geoCoords.get(j);
294                    if (pt.getX() > 0 && pt.getX() < left) {
295                        left = pt.getX();
296                    }
297                }
298            }
299            ptGeo = new Point2D.Double(left, top);
300        } catch (Exception ex) {
301            System.out.println("Failed to create control point in MultiPointHandler.getControlPoint");
302        }
303        return ptGeo;
304    }
305    private static String getBboxFromCoords(ArrayList<Point2D> geoCoords) {
306        //var ptGeo = null;
307        String bbox = null;
308        try {
309            int j = 0;
310            Point2D pt = null;
311            double left = geoCoords.get(0).getX();
312            double top = geoCoords.get(0).getY();
313            double right = geoCoords.get(0).getX();
314            double bottom = geoCoords.get(0).getY();
315            for (j = 1; j < geoCoords.size(); j++) {
316                pt = geoCoords.get(j);
317                if (pt.getX() < left) {
318                    left = pt.getX();
319                }
320                if (pt.getX() > right) {
321                    right = pt.getX();
322                }
323                if (pt.getY() > top) {
324                    top = pt.getY();
325                }
326                if (pt.getY() < bottom) {
327                    bottom = pt.getY();
328                }
329            }
330            //if geoCoords crosses the IDL
331            if (right - left > 180) {
332                //There must be at least one x value on either side of +/-180. Also, there is at least
333                //one positive value to the left of +/-180 and negative x value to the right of +/-180.
334                //We are using the orientation with the north pole on top so we can keep
335                //the existing value for top. Then the left value will be the least positive x value
336                //left = geoCoords[0].x;
337                left = 180;
338                right = -180;
339                for (j = 0; j < geoCoords.size(); j++) {
340                    pt = geoCoords.get(j);
341                    if (pt.getX() > 0 && pt.getX() < left) {
342                        left = pt.getX();
343                    }
344                    if (pt.getX() < 0 && pt.getX() > right) {
345                        right = pt.getX();
346                    }
347                }
348            }
349            //ptGeo = new armyc2.c2sd.graphics2d.Point2D(left, top);
350            bbox = Double.toString(left) + "," + Double.toString(bottom) + "," + Double.toString(right) + "," + Double.toString(top);
351        } catch (Exception ex) {
352            System.out.println("Failed to create control point in MultiPointHandler.getBboxFromCoords");
353        }
354        //return ptGeo;            
355        return bbox;
356    }

358    private static boolean crossesIDL(ArrayList<Point2D> geoCoords) {
359        boolean result = false;
360        Point2D pt2d = getControlPoint(geoCoords);
361        double left = pt2d.getX();
362        Point2D ptTemp = null;
363        int n = geoCoords.size();
364        //for (int j = 0; j < geoCoords.size(); j++) 
365        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
366            ptTemp = geoCoords.get(j);
367            if (Math.abs(ptTemp.getX() - left) > 180) {
368                return true;
369            }
370        }
371        return result;
372    }

506    /**
507     * Assumes bbox is of form left, right, bottom, top and it is currently only
508     * using the width to calculate a reasonable scale. If the original scale is
509     * within the max and min range it returns the original scale.
510     *
511     * @param bbox
512     * @param origScale
513     * @return
514     */
515    private static double getReasonableScale(String bbox, double origScale) {
516        double scale = origScale;
517        try {
518            String[] bounds = bbox.split(",");
519            double left = Double.valueOf(bounds[0]);
520            double right = Double.valueOf(bounds[2]);
521            double top = Double.valueOf(bounds[3]);
522            double bottom = Double.valueOf(bounds[1]);
523            //return a somewhat arbitrary scale value for unreasonable extents, i.e. 1000 is typical
524            //earth circumference/2 meters * 39.3701 inches/meter * 96 pixels/inch * 1000 pixels wide
525            //features will shrink as the globe gets shrinks less than 1000 pixels across
526            if (left == -180 && right == 180) {
527                return 7.573e7; //was origScale
528            } else if (left == 180 && right == -180) {
529                return 7.573e7; //was origScale
530            }
531            POINT2 ul = new POINT2(left, top);
532            POINT2 ur = new POINT2(right, top);
533            POINT2 lr = new POINT2(right, bottom);
534            //double widthInMeters = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_distance(ul, ur, null, null);
535            double widthInMeters = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_distance(ul, lr, null, null);
536            double maxWidthInPixels = _maxPixelWidth;
537            double minScale = (maxWidthInPixels / widthInMeters) * (1.0d / 96.0d) * (1.0d / 39.37d);
538            minScale = 1.0d / minScale;
539            if (origScale < minScale) {
540                return minScale;
541            }
542
543            double minWidthInPixels = _minPixelWidth;
544            double maxScale = (minWidthInPixels / widthInMeters) * (1.0d / 96.0d) * (1.0d / 39.37d);
545            maxScale = 1.0d / maxScale;
546            if (origScale > maxScale) {
547                return maxScale;
548            }
549        } catch (NumberFormatException exc) {
550        }
551        return scale;
552    }

927    private static boolean getBasicShapes(MilStdSymbol milStd,
928            Object clipArea,
929            IPointConversion ipc,
930            int symStd) {
931        //String symbolId=mss.getSymbolID();
932        int linetype = CELineArray.CGetLinetypeFromString(milStd.getSymbolID(), symStd);
933        ArrayList<Double> AM = null;
934        ArrayList<Double> AN = null;
935        double buffer=0,r=0;
936        boolean result = false;
937        switch (linetype) {
938            case TacticalLines.PBS_CIRCLE:
939                AM = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE);
940                AN = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AN_AZIMUTH);                
941                if(AM.size()==1)
942                {
943                    r=AM.get(0);
944                    AM.add(r);
945                    buffer=0;
946                    AM.add(buffer);
947                }
948                else if(AM.size()==2)
949                {
950                    r=AM.get(0);
951                    buffer=AM.get(1);
952                    AM.set(1, r);
953                    AM.add(buffer);
954                }
955                else if(AM.size()==3)
956                {
957                    r=AM.get(0);
958                    AM.set(1, r);
959                }
960                result = true;
961                break;
962            case TacticalLines.BS_ELLIPSE:
963            case TacticalLines.PBS_ELLIPSE:
964                AM = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE);
965                AN = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AN_AZIMUTH);                
966                if(AM.size()==1)
967                {
968                    r=AM.get(0);
969                    AM.add(r);
970                    buffer=0;
971                    AM.add(buffer);
972                }                
973                if(AM.size()==2)
974                {
975                    AM.add(0d);
976                }                
977                result = true;
978                break;
979            default:
980                return false;
981        }
982        //there must be an AN array with an element
983        if (AN == null) {
984            AN = new ArrayList<Double>();
985        }
986        if (AN.isEmpty() ){
987            AN.add(new Double(0));
988        }
989        ArrayList coords = milStd.getCoordinates();
990        double pivotX = ((Point2D.Double) coords.get(0)).x;
991        double pivotY = ((Point2D.Double) coords.get(0)).y;
992        double semiMajor = AM.get(0);
993        double semiMinor = AM.get(1);
994        double rotation = AN.get(0);
995        buffer=AM.get(2);
996        String strAltitudeMode = milStd.getAltitudeMode();
997        if (strAltitudeMode.isEmpty()) {
998            strAltitudeMode = "clampToGround";
999        }
1000        KmlOptions.AltitudeMode altitudeMode = KmlOptions.AltitudeMode.fromString(strAltitudeMode);
1001        //get buffer fill shape from JavaRendererServer, pass the GeoPoints
1002        ArrayList<GeoPoint> geoPts = XsltCoordinateWrapper.getEllipsePoints(pivotX, pivotY, altitudeMode, semiMajor+buffer, semiMinor+buffer, 0, 0, rotation);
1003        ArrayList<Point2D> coordinates = new ArrayList();
1004        double x = 0, y = 0;
1005        for (int j = 0; j < geoPts.size(); j++) {
1006            x = geoPts.get(j).x;
1007            y = geoPts.get(j).y;
1008            coordinates.add(new Point2D.Double(x, y));
1009        }
1010        milStd.setCoordinates(coordinates);
1011        clsRenderer.render_Shape(milStd, ipc, clipArea, ShapeInfo.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL, null, milStd.getFillColor(), 0);
1012        //get the outline and hatch shapes
1013        ArrayList<GeoPoint> geoPts2 = XsltCoordinateWrapper.getEllipsePoints(pivotX, pivotY, altitudeMode, semiMajor, semiMinor, 0, 0, rotation);
1014        ArrayList<Point2D> coordinates2 = new ArrayList();
1015        for (int j = 0; j < geoPts2.size(); j++) {
1016            x = geoPts2.get(j).x;
1017            y = geoPts2.get(j).y;
1018            coordinates2.add(new Point2D.Double(x, y));
1019        }            
1020        milStd.setCoordinates(coordinates2);
1021        clsRenderer.render_Shape(milStd, ipc, clipArea, ShapeInfo.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE, milStd.getLineColor(), null, milStd.getPatternFillType());
1022        
1023        milStd.setModifierShapes(new ArrayList<ShapeInfo>());
1024        return result;
1025    }

1242
1243            if (symbolModifiers != null || symbolAttributes != null) {
1244                populateModifiers(symbolModifiers, symbolAttributes, mSymbol);
1245            } else {
1246                mSymbol.setFillColor(null);
1247            }
1248
1249            if (mSymbol.getFillColor() != null) {

1251                //fillColor = Integer.toHexString(fc.getRGB());

1260            boolean isBasicShape = false;

1264            } else {

1266                isBasicShape = getBasicShapes(mSymbol, bboxCoords, ipc, symStd);
1267            }
1268            if (!isBasicShape) {
1269                if (bboxCoords == null) {
1270                    Rectangle clipBounds = getOverscanClipBounds(rect, ipc);
1271                    clsRenderer.renderWithPolylines(mSymbol, ipc, clipBounds);
1272                } else {
1273                    clsRenderer.renderWithPolylines(mSymbol, ipc, bboxCoords);
1274                }
1275            }
1276
1277            shapes = mSymbol.getSymbolShapes();
1278            modifiers = mSymbol.getModifierShapes();
1279

1281            ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>> polylines = null;
1282            ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>> newPolylines = null;
1283            ArrayList<Point2D> newLine = null;

1285                polylines = shape.getPolylines();
1286                //System.out.println("pixel polylines: " + String.valueOf(polylines));
1287                newPolylines = ConvertPolylinePixelsToCoords(polylines, ipc, normalize);
1288                shape.setPolylines(newPolylines);
1289            }
1290
1291            for (ShapeInfo label : modifiers) {
1292                Point2D pixelCoord = label.getModifierStringPosition();
1293                if (pixelCoord == null) {
1294                    pixelCoord = label.getGlyphPosition();
1295                }
1296                Point2D geoCoord = ipc.PixelsToGeo(pixelCoord);
1297
1298                if (normalize) {
1299                    geoCoord = NormalizeCoordToGECoord(geoCoord);
1300                }
1301
1302                double latitude = geoCoord.getY();
1303                double longitude = geoCoord.getX();
1304                label.setModifierStringPosition(new Point2D.Double(longitude, latitude));
1305
1306            }   
1307
1308            ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
1309            mSymbol.setModifierShapes(modifiers);
1310            mSymbol.setSymbolShapes(shapes);
1311
1312        } catch (Exception exc) {
1313            System.out.println(exc.getMessage());
1314            System.out.println("Symbol Code: " + symbolCode);
1315            exc.printStackTrace();
1316        }
1317
1318        boolean debug = false;
1319        if (debug == true) {
1320            System.out.println("Symbol Code: " + symbolCode);

1343    private static ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>> ConvertPolylinePixelsToCoords(ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>> polylines, IPointConversion ipc, Boolean normalize) {
1344        ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>> newPolylines = new ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>>();
1345
1346        double latitude = 0;
1347        double longitude = 0;
1348        ArrayList<Point2D> newLine = null;
1349        try {
1350            for (ArrayList<Point2D> line : polylines) {
1351                newLine = new ArrayList<Point2D>();
1352                for (Point2D pt : line) {
1353                    Point2D geoCoord = ipc.PixelsToGeo(pt);
1354
1355                    if (normalize) {
1356                        geoCoord = NormalizeCoordToGECoord(geoCoord);
1357                    }
1358
1359                    latitude = geoCoord.getY();
1360                    longitude = geoCoord.getX();
1361                    newLine.add(new Point2D.Double(longitude, latitude));
1362                }
1363                newPolylines.add(newLine);
1364            }
1365        } catch (Exception exc) {
1366            System.out.println(exc.getMessage());
1367            exc.printStackTrace();
1368        }
1369        return newPolylines;
1370    }

1666    private static Rectangle getOverscanClipBounds(Rectangle rect, IPointConversion ipc) {
1667        if (rect == null)
1668            return null;
1669        double maxWidth = Math.abs(ipc.GeoToPixels(new Point2D.Double(180, 0)).getX() - ipc.GeoToPixels(new Point2D.Double(0, 0)).getX());
1670        double maxHeight = Math.abs(ipc.GeoToPixels(new Point2D.Double(0, 90)).getY() - ipc.GeoToPixels(new Point2D.Double(0, -90)).getY());
1671        double overScanScale = RendererSettings.getInstance().getOverscanScale();
1672        if (rect.width * overScanScale > maxWidth) {
1673            overScanScale = maxWidth / rect.width;
1674        }
1675        if (rect.height * overScanScale > maxHeight) {
1676            overScanScale = maxHeight / rect.height;
1677        }
1678        return new Rectangle((int) (rect.x - (rect.width * (overScanScale - 1)) / 2), (int) (rect.y - (rect.height * (overScanScale - 1)) / 2), (int) (rect.width * overScanScale), (int) (rect.height * overScanScale));
1679    }

1805            if (rect != null) {

1807            }
1808            if (jsonOutput != null) {
1809                System.out.println(jsonOutput.toString());
1810            }
1811        }
1812        return jsonOutput.toString();
1813
1814    }

1816    private static SymbolInfo MilStdSymbolToSymbolInfo(MilStdSymbol symbol) {
1817        SymbolInfo si = null;
1818
1819        ArrayList<TextInfo> tiList = new ArrayList<TextInfo>();
1820        ArrayList<LineInfo> liList = new ArrayList<LineInfo>();
1821
1822        TextInfo tiTemp = null;
1823        LineInfo liTemp = null;
1824        ShapeInfo siTemp = null;
1825
1826        ArrayList<ShapeInfo> lines = symbol.getSymbolShapes();
1827        ArrayList<ShapeInfo> modifiers = symbol.getModifierShapes();
1828
1829        int lineCount = lines.size();
1830        int modifierCount = modifiers.size();
1831        for (int i = 0; i < lineCount; i++) {
1832            siTemp = lines.get(i);
1833            if (siTemp.getPolylines() != null) {
1834                liTemp = new LineInfo();
1835                liTemp.setFillColor(siTemp.getFillColor());
1836                liTemp.setLineColor(siTemp.getLineColor());
1837                liTemp.setPolylines(siTemp.getPolylines());
1838                liTemp.setStroke(siTemp.getStroke());
1839                liList.add(liTemp);
1840            }
1841        }
1842
1843        for (int j = 0; j < modifierCount; j++) {
1844            tiTemp = new TextInfo();
1845            siTemp = modifiers.get(j);
1846            if (siTemp.getModifierString() != null) {
1847                tiTemp.setModifierString(siTemp.getModifierString());
1848                tiTemp.setModifierStringPosition(siTemp.getModifierStringPosition());
1849                tiTemp.setModifierStringAngle(siTemp.getModifierStringAngle());
1850                tiList.add(tiTemp);
1851            }
1852        }
1853        si = new SymbolInfo(tiList, liList);
1854        return si;
1855    }

1857    /**
1858     * Populates a symbol with the modifiers from a JSON string. This function
1859     * will overwrite any previously populated modifier data.

1862     * modifier data.
1863     * @param saAttributes a JSON formatted string containing all the symbol
1864     * attribute data.

1866     * @return
1867     */
1868    private static boolean populateModifiers(SparseArray<String> saModifiers, SparseArray<String> saAttributes, MilStdSymbol symbol) {
1869        SparseArray<String> modifiers = new SparseArray<String>();
1870        SparseArray<String> attributes = saAttributes.clone();
1871
1872        // Stores array graphic modifiers for MilStdSymbol;
1873        ArrayList<Double> altitudes = null;
1874        ArrayList<Double> azimuths = null;
1875        ArrayList<Double> distances = null;
1876
1877        // Stores colors for symbol.
1878        String fillColor = null;
1879        String lineColor = null;
1880        String textColor = null;
1881        String textBackgroundColor = null;
1882
1883        int lineWidth = 0;
1884        int symstd = 0;
1885        String altMode = null;
1886        boolean useDashArray = symbol.getUseDashArray();
1887        boolean usePatternFill = symbol.getUseFillPattern();
1888        int patternFillType = 0;
1889        boolean hideOptionalLabels = false;
1890        DistanceUnit distanceUnit = null;
1891        DistanceUnit altitudeUnit = null;
1892
1893        String symbolFillIDs = null;
1894        String symbolFillIconSize = null;
1895
1896        try {
1897
1898            // The following attirubtes are labels.  All of them
1899            // are strings and can be added on the creation of the
1900            // MilStdSymbol by adding to a Map and passing in the
1901            // modifiers parameter.
1902            if (saModifiers != null) {
1903                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.C_QUANTITY) >= 0) {
1904                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.C_QUANTITY, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.C_QUANTITY)));
1905                }
1906
1907                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.H_ADDITIONAL_INFO_1) >= 0) {
1908                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.H_ADDITIONAL_INFO_1, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.H_ADDITIONAL_INFO_1)));
1909                }
1910
1911                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.H1_ADDITIONAL_INFO_2) >= 0) {
1912                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.H1_ADDITIONAL_INFO_2, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.H1_ADDITIONAL_INFO_2)));
1913                }
1914
1915                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.H2_ADDITIONAL_INFO_3) >= 0) {
1916                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.H2_ADDITIONAL_INFO_3, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.H2_ADDITIONAL_INFO_3)));
1917                }
1918
1919                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.N_HOSTILE) >= 0) {
1920                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.N_HOSTILE, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.N_HOSTILE)));
1921                }
1922
1923                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.Q_DIRECTION_OF_MOVEMENT) >= 0) {
1924                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.Q_DIRECTION_OF_MOVEMENT, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.Q_DIRECTION_OF_MOVEMENT)));
1925                }
1926
1927                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.T_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_1) >= 0) {
1928                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.T_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_1, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.T_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_1)));
1929                }
1930
1931                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.T1_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_2) >= 0) {
1932                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.T1_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_2, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.T1_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_2)));
1933                }
1934
1935                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.V_EQUIP_TYPE) >= 0) {
1936                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.V_EQUIP_TYPE, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.V_EQUIP_TYPE)));
1937                }
1938
1939                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.W_DTG_1) >= 0) {
1940                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.W_DTG_1, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.W_DTG_1)));
1941                }
1942
1943                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.W1_DTG_2) >= 0) {
1944                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.W1_DTG_2, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.W1_DTG_2)));
1945                }
1946
1947                //Required multipoint modifier arrays
1948                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.X_ALTITUDE_DEPTH) >= 0) {
1949                    altitudes = new ArrayList<Double>();
1950                    String[] arrAltitudes = String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.X_ALTITUDE_DEPTH)).split(",");
1951                    for (String x : arrAltitudes) {
1952                        if (x.equals("") != true) {
1953                            altitudes.add(Double.parseDouble(x));
1954                        }
1955                    }
1956                }
1957
1958                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE) >= 0) {
1959                    distances = new ArrayList<Double>();
1960                    String[] arrDistances = String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE)).split(",");
1961                    for (String am : arrDistances) {
1962                        if (am.equals("") != true) {
1963                            distances.add(Double.parseDouble(am));
1964                        }
1965                    }
1966                }
1967
1968                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.AN_AZIMUTH) >= 0) {
1969                    azimuths = new ArrayList<Double>();
1970                    String[] arrAzimuths = String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.AN_AZIMUTH)).split(",");;
1971                    for (String an : arrAzimuths) {
1972                        if (an.equals("") != true) {
1973                            azimuths.add(Double.parseDouble(an));
1974                        }
1975                    }
1976                }
1977            }
1978            if (saAttributes != null) {
1979                // These properties are ints, not labels, they are colors.//////////////////
1980                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.FillColor) >= 0) {
1981                    fillColor = (String) saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.FillColor);
1982                }
1983
1984                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.LineColor) >= 0) {
1985                    lineColor = (String) saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.LineColor);
1986                }
1987
1988                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.LineWidth) >= 0) {
1989                    lineWidth = Integer.parseInt(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.LineWidth));
1990                }
1991                
1992                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.TextColor) >= 0) {
1993                    textColor = (String) saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.TextColor);
1994                }
1995                
1996                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.TextBackgroundColor) >= 0) {
1997                    textBackgroundColor = (String) saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.TextBackgroundColor);
1998                }
1999
2000                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.SymbologyStandard) >= 0) {
2001                    symstd = Integer.parseInt(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.SymbologyStandard));
2002                    symbol.setSymbologyStandard(symstd);
2003                }
2004
2005                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.AltitudeMode) >= 0) {
2006                    altMode = saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.AltitudeMode);
2007                }
2008
2009                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.UseDashArray) >= 0) {
2010                    useDashArray = Boolean.parseBoolean(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.UseDashArray));
2011                }
2012
2013                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.UsePatternFill) >= 0) {
2014                    usePatternFill = Boolean.parseBoolean(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.UsePatternFill));
2015                }
2016
2017                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.PatternFillType) >= 0) {
2018                    patternFillType = Integer.parseInt((saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.PatternFillType)));
2019                }
2020
2021                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.HideOptionalLabels) >= 0) {
2022                    hideOptionalLabels = Boolean.parseBoolean(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.HideOptionalLabels));
2023                }
2024
2025                if(saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.AltitudeUnits) >= 0) {
2026                    altitudeUnit = DistanceUnit.parse(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.AltitudeUnits));
2027                }
2028
2029                if(saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.DistanceUnits) >= 0) {
2030                    distanceUnit = DistanceUnit.parse(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.DistanceUnits));
2031                }
2032            }
2033
2034            symbol.setModifierMap(modifiers);
2035
2036            if (fillColor != null && fillColor.equals("") == false) {
2037                symbol.setFillColor(SymbolUtilities.getColorFromHexString(fillColor));
2038            } 
2039
2040            if (lineColor != null && lineColor.equals("") == false) {
2041                symbol.setLineColor(SymbolUtilities.getColorFromHexString(lineColor));
2042            }
2043            else if(symbol.getLineColor()==null)
2044                symbol.setLineColor(Color.black);
2045
2046            if (lineWidth > 0) {
2047                symbol.setLineWidth(lineWidth);
2048            }
2049            
2050            if (textColor != null && textColor.equals("") == false) {
2051                symbol.setTextColor(SymbolUtilities.getColorFromHexString(textColor));
2052            }
2053            else
2054                symbol.setTextColor(symbol.getLineColor());
2055                
2056            if (textBackgroundColor != null && textBackgroundColor.equals("") == false) {
2057                symbol.setTextBackgroundColor(SymbolUtilities.getColorFromHexString(textBackgroundColor));
2058            }
2059
2060            if (altMode != null) {
2061                symbol.setAltitudeMode(altMode);
2062            }
2063
2064            symbol.setUseDashArray(useDashArray);
2065            symbol.setUseFillPattern(usePatternFill);
2066            if(SymbolUtilities.isBasicShape(symbol.getSymbolID()))
2067                symbol.setPatternFillType(patternFillType);
2068            symbol.setHideOptionalLabels(hideOptionalLabels);
2069            symbol.setAltitudeUnit(altitudeUnit);
2070            symbol.setDistanceUnit(distanceUnit);
2071
2072            // Check grpahic modifiers variables.  If we set earlier, populate
2073            // the fields, otherwise, ignore.
2074            if (altitudes != null) {
2075                symbol.setModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.X_ALTITUDE_DEPTH, altitudes);
2076            }
2077            if (distances != null) {
2078                symbol.setModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE, distances);
2079            }
2080
2081            if (azimuths != null) {
2082                symbol.setModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AN_AZIMUTH, azimuths);
2083            }
2084
2085            //Check if sector range fan has required min range
2086            if (SymbolUtilities.getBasicSymbolID(symbol.getSymbolID()).equals("G*F*AXS---****X")) {
2087                if (symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AN_AZIMUTH) != null
2088                        && symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE) != null) {
2089                    int anCount = symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AN_AZIMUTH).size();
2090                    int amCount = symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE).size();
2091                    ArrayList<Double> am = null;
2092                    if (amCount < ((anCount / 2) + 1)) {
2093                        am = symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE);
2094                        if (am.get(0) != 0.0) {
2095                            am.add(0, 0.0);
2096                        }
2097                    }
2098                }
2099            }
2100        } catch (Exception exc2) {
2101            Log.e("MPH.populateModifiers", exc2.getMessage(), exc2);
2102        }
2103        return true;
2104
2105    }

2310    private static String KMLize(String id, String name,
2311            String description,
2312            String symbolCode,
2313            ArrayList<ShapeInfo> shapes,
2314            ArrayList<ShapeInfo> modifiers,
2315            IPointConversion ipc,
2316            boolean normalize,
2317            Color textColor,
2318            boolean wasClipped) {
2319
2320        java.lang.StringBuilder kml = new java.lang.StringBuilder();
2321
2322        ShapeInfo tempModifier = null;
2323
2324        String cdataStart = "<![CDATA[";
2325        String cdataEnd = "]]>";
2326
2327        int len = shapes.size();
2328        kml.append("<Folder id=\"").append(id).append("\">");
2329        kml.append("<name>").append(cdataStart).append(name).append(cdataEnd).append("</name>");
2330        kml.append("<visibility>1</visibility>");
2331        kml.append("<description>").append(cdataStart).append(description).append(cdataEnd).append("</description>");
2332        kml.append("<ExtendedData>");
2333        kml.append("<Data name=\"symbolID\"><value>").append(symbolCode).append("</value></Data>");
2334        kml.append("<Data name=\"wasClipped\"><value>").append(wasClipped).append("</value></Data>");
2335        kml.append("</ExtendedData>");
2336        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
2337
2338            String shapesToAdd = ShapeToKMLString(name, description, symbolCode, shapes.get(i), ipc, normalize);
2339            kml.append(shapesToAdd);
2340        }
2341
2342        int len2 = modifiers.size();
2343
2344        for (int j = 0; j < len2; j++) {
2345
2346            tempModifier = modifiers.get(j);
2347
2348            //if(geMap)//if using google earth
2349            //assume kml text is going to be centered
2350            //AdjustModifierPointToCenter(tempModifier);
2351
2352            String labelsToAdd = LabelToKMLString(tempModifier, ipc, normalize, textColor);
2353            kml.append(labelsToAdd);
2354        }
2355
2356        kml.append("</Folder>");
2357        return kml.toString();
2358    }

2375        ShapeInfo tempModifier = null;
2376
2377        int len = shapes.size();
2378        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
2379            if (jstr.length() > 0) {
2380                jstr += ",";
2381            }
2382            String shapesToAdd = ShapeToJSONString(shapes.get(i), ipc, geMap, normalize);
2383            if (shapesToAdd.length() > 0) {
2384                if (shapesToAdd.startsWith("line", 2)) {
2385                    if (lines.length() > 0) {
2386                        lines += ",";
2387                    }
2388
2389                    lines += shapesToAdd;
2390                } else if (shapesToAdd.startsWith("polygon", 2)) {
2391                    if (polygons.length() > 0) {
2392                        polygons += ",";
2393                    }
2394
2395                    polygons += shapesToAdd;
2396                }
2397            }
2398        }
2399
2400        jstr += "\"polygons\": [" + polygons + "],"
2401                + "\"lines\": [" + lines + "],";
2402        int len2 = modifiers.size();
2403        labels = "";
2404        for (int j = 0; j < len2; j++) {
2405            tempModifier = modifiers.get(j);
2406            if (geMap) {
2407                AdjustModifierPointToCenter(tempModifier);
2408            }
2409            String labelsToAdd = LabelToJSONString(tempModifier, ipc, normalize);
2410            if (labelsToAdd.length() > 0) {
2411                if (labels.length() > 0) {
2412                    labels += ",";
2413                }
2414
2415                labels += labelsToAdd;
2416
2417            }
2418        }
2419        jstr += "\"labels\": [" + labels + "]";
2420        return jstr;
2421    }

2423    private static Color getIdealTextBackgroundColor(Color fgColor) {
2424        //ErrorLogger.LogMessage("SymbolDraw","getIdealtextBGColor", "in function", Level.SEVERE);
2425        try {
2426            //an array of three elements containing the
2427            //hue, saturation, and brightness (in that order),
2428            //of the color with the indicated red, green, and blue components/
2429            float hsbvals[] = new float[3];
2430
2431            if (fgColor != null) {/*
2432                 Color.RGBtoHSB(fgColor.getRed(), fgColor.getGreen(), fgColor.getBlue(), hsbvals);
2433
2434                 if(hsbvals != null)
2435                 {
2436                 //ErrorLogger.LogMessage("SymbolDraw","getIdealtextBGColor", "length: " + String.valueOf(hsbvals.length));
2437                 //ErrorLogger.LogMessage("SymbolDraw","getIdealtextBGColor", "H: " + String.valueOf(hsbvals[0]) + " S: " + String.valueOf(hsbvals[1]) + " B: " + String.valueOf(hsbvals[2]),Level.SEVERE);
2438                 if(hsbvals[2] > 0.6)
2439                 return Color.BLACK;
2440                 else
2441                 return Color.WHITE;
2442                 }*/
2443
2444                int nThreshold = RendererSettings.getInstance().getTextBackgroundAutoColorThreshold();//160;
2445                int bgDelta = (int) ((fgColor.getRed() * 0.299) + (fgColor.getGreen() * 0.587) + (fgColor.getBlue() * 0.114));
2446                //ErrorLogger.LogMessage("bgDelta: " + String.valueOf(255-bgDelta));
2447                //if less than threshold, black, otherwise white.
2448                //return (255 - bgDelta < nThreshold) ? Color.BLACK : Color.WHITE;//new Color(0, 0, 0, fgColor.getAlpha())
2449                return (255 - bgDelta < nThreshold) ? new Color(0, 0, 0, fgColor.getAlpha()) : new Color(255, 255, 255, fgColor.getAlpha());
2450            }
2451        } catch (Exception exc) {
2452            ErrorLogger.LogException("SymbolDraw", "getIdealtextBGColor", exc);
2453        }
2454        return Color.WHITE;
2455    }

2546    private static String ShapeToGeoJSONString(ShapeInfo shapeInfo, IPointConversion ipc, boolean normalize) {
2547        StringBuilder JSONed = new StringBuilder();
2548        StringBuilder properties = new StringBuilder();
2549        StringBuilder geometry = new StringBuilder();
2550        String geometryType = null;
2551        /*
2552         NOTE: Google Earth / KML colors are backwards.
2553         They are ordered Alpha,Blue,Green,Red, not Red,Green,Blue,Aplha like the rest of the world
2554         * */
2555        Color lineColor = shapeInfo.getLineColor();
2556        Color fillColor = shapeInfo.getFillColor();
2557
2558        if (shapeInfo.getShapeType() == ShapeInfo.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL || fillColor != null) {
2559            geometryType = "\"Polygon\"";
2560        } else //if(shapeInfo.getShapeType() == ShapeInfo.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE)
2561        {
2562            geometryType = "\"MultiLineString\"";
2563        }
2564
2565        BasicStroke stroke = null;
2566        stroke = (BasicStroke) shapeInfo.getStroke();
2567        int lineWidth = 4;
2568
2569        if (stroke != null) {
2570            lineWidth = (int) stroke.getLineWidth();
2571            //lineWidth++;
2572            //System.out.println("lineWidth: " + String.valueOf(lineWidth));
2573        }
2574
2575        //generate JSON properties for feature
2576        properties.append("\"properties\":{");
2577        properties.append("\"label\":\"\",");
2578        if (lineColor != null) {
2579            properties.append("\"strokeColor\":\"" + SymbolUtilities.colorToHexString(lineColor, false) + "\",");
2580            properties.append("\"lineOpacity\":" + String.valueOf(lineColor.getAlpha() / 255f) + ",");
2581        }
2582        if (fillColor != null) {
2583            properties.append("\"fillColor\":\"" + SymbolUtilities.colorToHexString(fillColor, false) + "\",");
2584            properties.append("\"fillOpacity\":" + String.valueOf(fillColor.getAlpha() / 255f) + ",");
2585        }
2586        String strokeWidth = String.valueOf(lineWidth);
2587        properties.append("\"strokeWidth\":" + strokeWidth + ",");
2588        properties.append("\"strokeWeight\":" + strokeWidth + "");
2589        properties.append("}");
2590
2591        //generate JSON geometry for feature
2592        geometry.append("\"geometry\":{\"type\":");
2593        geometry.append(geometryType);
2594        geometry.append(",\"coordinates\":[");
2595
2596        ArrayList shapesArray = shapeInfo.getPolylines();
2597
2598        for (int i = 0; i < shapesArray.size(); i++) {
2599            ArrayList pointList = (ArrayList) shapesArray.get(i);
2600
2601            normalize = normalizePoints(pointList, ipc);
2602
2603            geometry.append("[");
2604
2605            //System.out.println("Pixel Coords:");
2606            for (int j = 0; j < pointList.size(); j++) {
2607                Point2D coord = (Point2D) pointList.get(j);
2608                Point2D geoCoord = ipc.PixelsToGeo(coord);
2609                //M. Deutch 9-27-11
2610                if (normalize) {
2611                    geoCoord = NormalizeCoordToGECoord(geoCoord);
2612                }
2613                double latitude = Math.round(geoCoord.getY() * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0;
2614                double longitude = Math.round(geoCoord.getX() * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0;
2615
2616                //fix for fill crossing DTL
2617                if (normalize && fillColor != null) {
2618                    if (longitude > 0) {
2619                        longitude -= 360;
2620                    }
2621                }
2622
2623                //diagnostic M. Deutch 10-18-11
2624                //set the point as geo so that the 
2625                //coord.setLocation(longitude, latitude);
2626                coord = new Point2D.Double(longitude, latitude);
2627                pointList.set(j, coord);
2628                //end section
2629
2630                geometry.append("[");
2631                geometry.append(longitude);
2632                geometry.append(",");
2633                geometry.append(latitude);
2634                geometry.append("]");
2635
2636                if (j < (pointList.size() - 1)) {
2637                    geometry.append(",");
2638                }
2639            }
2640
2641            geometry.append("]");
2642
2643            if (i < (shapesArray.size() - 1)) {
2644                geometry.append(",");
2645            }
2646        }
2647        geometry.append("]}");
2648
2649        JSONed.append("{\"type\":\"Feature\",");
2650        JSONed.append(properties.toString());
2651        JSONed.append(",");
2652        JSONed.append(geometry.toString());
2653        JSONed.append("}");
2654
2655        return JSONed.toString();
2656    }

2658    private static String GeoJSONize(ArrayList<ShapeInfo> shapes, ArrayList<ShapeInfo> modifiers, IPointConversion ipc, boolean normalize, Color textColor, Color textBackgroundColor) {
2659
2660        String jstr = "";
2661        ShapeInfo tempModifier = null;
2662        StringBuilder fc = new StringBuilder();//JSON feature collection
2663
2664        fc.append("[");
2665
2666        int len = shapes.size();
2667        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
2668
2669            String shapesToAdd = ShapeToGeoJSONString(shapes.get(i), ipc, normalize);
2670            if (shapesToAdd.length() > 0) {
2671                fc.append(shapesToAdd);
2672            }
2673            if (i < len - 1) {
2674                fc.append(",");
2675            }
2676        }
2677
2678        int len2 = modifiers.size();
2679
2680        for (int j = 0; j < len2; j++) {
2681            tempModifier = modifiers.get(j);
2682
2683            String labelsToAdd = LabelToGeoJSONString(tempModifier, ipc, normalize, textColor, textBackgroundColor);
2684            if (labelsToAdd.length() > 0) {
2685                fc.append(",");
2686                fc.append(labelsToAdd);
2687            }
2688        }
2689        fc.append("]");
2690        String GeoJSON = fc.toString();
2691        return GeoJSON;
2692    }

2702    private static String GenerateGroundOverlayKML(
2703            String urlImage, IPointConversion ipc,
2704            Rectangle symbolBounds,
2705            boolean normalize)//, ArrayList<ShapeInfo> shapes)
2706    {
2707        //int shapeType = -1;
2708        double x = 0;
2709        double y = 0;
2710        double height = 0;
2711        double width = 0;
2712        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
2713        Boolean lineFill = false;
2714        Map<String, String> params = null;
2715        int symbolSize = 0;
2716        int imageOffset = 0;
2717
2718        try {
2719            //if it's a line pattern, we need to know how big the symbols
2720            //are so we can increase the size of the image.
2721            int index = -1;
2722            index = urlImage.indexOf(SYMBOL_LINE_IDS);
2723
2724            if (index > 0)//if(urlImage contains SYMBOL_LINE_IDS)
2725            {
2726                lineFill = true;
2727                if (params.containsKey(SYMBOL_FILL_ICON_SIZE)) {
2728                    String size = (String) params.get(SYMBOL_FILL_ICON_SIZE);
2729                    symbolSize = Integer.decode(size);// getInteger(size);
2730                } else {
2731                }
2732                imageOffset = (symbolSize / 2) + 3;//+3 to make room for rotation
2733            }
2734
2735            Rectangle bounds = null;
2736            bounds = symbolBounds;
2737            height = bounds.getHeight() + (imageOffset * 2);
2738            width = bounds.getWidth() + (imageOffset * 2);
2739            x = bounds.getX() - imageOffset;
2740            y = bounds.getY() - imageOffset;
2741
2742            Point2D coord = (Point2D) new Point2D.Double(x, y);
2743            Point2D topLeft = ipc.PixelsToGeo(coord);
2744            coord = (Point2D) new Point2D.Double(x + width, y + height);
2745            Point2D bottomRight = ipc.PixelsToGeo(coord);
2746
2747            if (normalize) {
2748                topLeft = NormalizeCoordToGECoord(topLeft);
2749                bottomRight = NormalizeCoordToGECoord(bottomRight);
2750            }
2751
2752            String cdataStart = "<![CDATA[";
2753            String cdataEnd = "]]>";
2754            //build kml
2755            sb.append("<GroundOverlay>");
2756            sb.append("<name>symbol fill</name>");
2757            sb.append("<description>symbol fill</description>");
2758            sb.append("<Icon>");
2759            sb.append("<href>");
2760            sb.append(cdataStart);
2761            sb.append(urlImage);
2762            sb.append(cdataEnd);
2763            sb.append("</href>");
2764            sb.append("</Icon>");
2765            sb.append("<LatLonBox>");
2766            sb.append("<north>");
2767            sb.append(String.valueOf(topLeft.getY()));
2768            sb.append("</north>");
2769            sb.append("<south>");
2770            sb.append(String.valueOf(bottomRight.getY()));
2771            sb.append("</south>");
2772            sb.append("<east>");
2773            sb.append(String.valueOf(bottomRight.getX()));
2774            sb.append("</east>");
2775            sb.append("<west>");
2776            sb.append(String.valueOf(topLeft.getX()));
2777            sb.append("</west>");
2778            sb.append("<rotation>");
2779            sb.append(0);
2780            sb.append("</rotation>");
2781            sb.append("</LatLonBox>");
2782            sb.append("</GroundOverlay>");
2783        } catch (Exception exc) {
2784            System.out.println(exc.getMessage());
2785            exc.printStackTrace();
2786        }
2787        String kml = sb.toString();
2788        return kml;
2789    }

2827    private static Boolean normalizePoints(ArrayList<Point2D.Double> shape, IPointConversion ipc) {
2828        ArrayList geoCoords = new ArrayList();
2829        int n = shape.size();
2830        //for (int j = 0; j < shape.size(); j++) 
2831        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
2832            Point2D coord = shape.get(j);
2833            Point2D geoCoord = ipc.PixelsToGeo(coord);
2834            geoCoord = NormalizeCoordToGECoord(geoCoord);
2835            double latitude = geoCoord.getY();
2836            double longitude = geoCoord.getX();
2837            Point2D pt2d = new Point2D.Double(longitude, latitude);
2838            geoCoords.add(pt2d);
2839        }
2840        Boolean normalize = crossesIDL(geoCoords);
2841        return normalize;
2842    }

2844    private static Boolean IsOnePointSymbolCode(String symbolCode) {
2845        int symStd = RendererSettings.getInstance().getSymbologyStandard();
2846        String basicCode = SymbolUtilities.getBasicSymbolID(symbolCode);
2847
2848        //some airspaces affected
2849        if (symbolCode.equals("CAKE-----------")) {
2850            return true;
2851        } else if (symbolCode.equals("CYLINDER-------")) {
2852            return true;
2853        } else if (symbolCode.equals("RADARC---------")) {
2854            return true;
2855        }
2856
2857        return false;
2858    }

2860    private static String ShapeToKMLString(String name,
2861            String description,
2862            String symbolCode,
2863            ShapeInfo shapeInfo,
2864            IPointConversion ipc,
2865            boolean normalize) {
2866
2867        java.lang.StringBuilder kml = new java.lang.StringBuilder();
2868
2869        Color lineColor = null;
2870        Color fillColor = null;
2871        String googleLineColor = null;
2872        String googleFillColor = null;
2873
2874        //String lineStyleId = "lineColor";
2875
2876        BasicStroke stroke = null;
2877        int lineWidth = 4;
2878
2879        symbolCode = JavaRendererUtilities.normalizeSymbolCode(symbolCode);
2880
2881        String cdataStart = "<![CDATA[";
2882        String cdataEnd = "]]>";
2883
2884        kml.append("<Placemark>");//("<Placemark id=\"" + id + "_mg" + "\">");
2885        //kml.append("<Style id=\"" + lineStyleId + "\">");
2886        kml.append("<Style>");
2887
2888        lineColor = shapeInfo.getLineColor();
2889        if (lineColor != null) {
2890            googleLineColor = Integer.toHexString(shapeInfo.getLineColor().toARGB());
2891
2892            stroke = (BasicStroke) shapeInfo.getStroke();
2893
2894            if (stroke != null) {
2895                lineWidth = (int) stroke.getLineWidth();
2896            }
2897
2898            googleLineColor = JavaRendererUtilities.ARGBtoABGR(googleLineColor);
2899
2900            kml.append("<LineStyle>");
2901            kml.append("<color>" + googleLineColor + "</color>");
2902            kml.append("<colorMode>normal</colorMode>");
2903            kml.append("<width>" + String.valueOf(lineWidth) + "</width>");
2904            kml.append("</LineStyle>");
2905        }
2906
2907        fillColor = shapeInfo.getFillColor();
2908        if (fillColor != null) {
2909            googleFillColor = Integer.toHexString(shapeInfo.getFillColor().toARGB());
2910
2911            googleFillColor = JavaRendererUtilities.ARGBtoABGR(googleFillColor);
2912
2913            kml.append("<PolyStyle>");
2914            kml.append("<color>" + googleFillColor + "</color>");
2915            kml.append("<colorMode>normal</colorMode>");
2916            kml.append("<fill>1</fill>");
2917            if (lineColor != null) {
2918                kml.append("<outline>1</outline>");
2919            } else {
2920                kml.append("<outline>0</outline>");
2921            }
2922            kml.append("</PolyStyle>");
2923        }
2924
2925        kml.append("</Style>");
2926
2927        ArrayList shapesArray = shapeInfo.getPolylines();
2928        int len = shapesArray.size();
2929        kml.append("<MultiGeometry>");
2930
2931        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
2932            ArrayList shape = (ArrayList) shapesArray.get(i);
2933            normalize = normalizePoints(shape, ipc);
2934            if (lineColor != null && fillColor == null) {
2935                kml.append("<LineString>");
2936                kml.append("<tessellate>1</tessellate>");
2937                kml.append("<altitudeMode>clampToGround</altitudeMode>");
2938                kml.append("<coordinates>");
2939                int n = shape.size();
2940                //for (int j = 0; j < shape.size(); j++) 
2941                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
2942                    Point2D coord = (Point2D) shape.get(j);
2943                    Point2D geoCoord = ipc.PixelsToGeo(coord);
2944                    if (normalize) {
2945                        geoCoord = NormalizeCoordToGECoord(geoCoord);
2946                    }
2947
2948                    double latitude = Math.round(geoCoord.getY() * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0;
2949                    double longitude = Math.round(geoCoord.getX() * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0;
2950
2951                    kml.append(longitude);
2952                    kml.append(",");
2953                    kml.append(latitude);
2954                    if(j<shape.size()-1)
2955                        kml.append(" ");
2956                }
2957
2958                kml.append("</coordinates>");
2959                kml.append("</LineString>");
2960            }
2961
2962            if (fillColor != null) {
2963
2964                if (i == 0) {
2965                    kml.append("<Polygon>");
2966                }
2967                //kml.append("<outerBoundaryIs>");
2968                if (i == 1 && len > 1) {
2969                    kml.append("<innerBoundaryIs>");
2970                } else {
2971                    kml.append("<outerBoundaryIs>");
2972                }
2973                kml.append("<LinearRing>");
2974                kml.append("<altitudeMode>clampToGround</altitudeMode>");
2975                kml.append("<tessellate>1</tessellate>");
2976                kml.append("<coordinates>");
2977
2978                //this section is a workaround for a google earth bug. Issue 417 was closed
2979                //for linestrings but they did not fix the smae issue for fills. If Google fixes the issue
2980                //for fills then this section will need to be commented or it will induce an error.
2981                double lastLongitude = Double.MIN_VALUE;
2982                if (normalize == false && IsOnePointSymbolCode(symbolCode)) {
2983                    int n = shape.size();
2984                    //for (int j = 0; j < shape.size(); j++) 
2985                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
2986                        Point2D coord = (Point2D) shape.get(j);
2987                        Point2D geoCoord = ipc.PixelsToGeo(coord);
2988                        double longitude = geoCoord.getX();
2989                        if (lastLongitude != Double.MIN_VALUE) {
2990                            if (Math.abs(longitude - lastLongitude) > 180d) {
2991                                normalize = true;
2992                                break;
2993                            }
2994                        }
2995                        lastLongitude = longitude;
2996                    }
2997                }
2998                int n = shape.size();
2999                //for (int j = 0; j < shape.size(); j++) 
3000                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
3001                    Point2D coord = (Point2D) shape.get(j);
3002                    Point2D geoCoord = ipc.PixelsToGeo(coord);
3003
3004                    double latitude = Math.round(geoCoord.getY() * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0;
3005                    double longitude = Math.round(geoCoord.getX() * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0;
3006
3007                    //fix for fill crossing DTL
3008                    if (normalize) {
3009                        if (longitude > 0) {
3010                            longitude -= 360;
3011                        }
3012                    }
3013
3014                    kml.append(longitude);
3015                    kml.append(",");
3016                    kml.append(latitude);
3017                    if(j<shape.size()-1)
3018                        kml.append(" ");
3019                }
3020
3021                kml.append("</coordinates>");
3022                kml.append("</LinearRing>");
3023                if (i == 1 && len > 1) {
3024                    kml.append("</innerBoundaryIs>");
3025                } else {
3026                    kml.append("</outerBoundaryIs>");
3027                }
3028                if (i == len - 1) {
3029                    kml.append("</Polygon>");
3030                }
3031            }
3032        }
3033
3034        kml.append("</MultiGeometry>");
3035        kml.append("</Placemark>");
3036
3037        return kml.toString();
3038    }

3203                double latitude = geoCoord.getY();
3204                double longitude = geoCoord.getX();
3205
3206                //diagnostic M. Deutch 10-18-11

3210

3221
3222            JSONed.append("]");

3226
3227                JSONed.append("\"");

3356    static String canRenderMultiPoint(MilStdSymbol symbol) {
3357        int symStd = symbol.getSymbologyStandard();
3358        String symbolID = symbol.getSymbolID();
3359        String basicID = SymbolUtilities.getBasicSymbolID(symbolID);
3360        SymbolDef sd = null;
3361        int dc = 99;
3362        int coordCount = symbol.getCoordinates().size();
3363
3364        try {
3365
3366            String message = "";
3367            if (SymbolDefTable.getInstance().HasSymbolDef(basicID, symStd)) {
3368                sd = SymbolDefTable.getInstance().getSymbolDef(basicID, symStd);
3369            }
3370
3371            if (sd != null) {
3372                dc = sd.getDrawCategory();
3373                if (coordCount < sd.getMinPoints()) {
3374                    message = ("symbolID: \"" + symbolID + "\" requires a minimum of " + String.valueOf(sd.getMinPoints()) + " points. " + String.valueOf(coordCount) + " are present.");
3375                    return message;
3376                }
3377            } else if (symbolID.startsWith("BS_")) {
3378                //Will need to be updated to do a more thorough check for
3379                //basic shapes and buffered basic shapes.
3380                //Return true for now.
3381                return "true";
3382            }
3383                        else if (symbolID.startsWith("BBS_")) {
3384                ArrayList<Double> AM = symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE);
3385                if(AM != null && AM.size() > 0 && AM.get(0) >= 0)
3386                        return "true";
3387                else
3388                        return "false: Buffered Basic Shapes require a width (AM)";
3389            } 
3390                        else if (symbolID.startsWith("PBS_")) 
3391                        {
3392                ArrayList<Double> AM = symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE);
3393                                
3394                                if(symbolID.equals("PBS_CIRCLE-----") || symbolID.equals("PBS_SQUARE-----"))
3395                {
3396                    if (AM != null && AM.size() > 0 && coordCount > 0)
3397                    {
3398                        return "true";
3399                    }
3400                    else
3401                    {
3402                        return ("false: " + symbolID + ", requires a width (AM) and 1 control point");
3403                    }
3404                }
3405                else if(symbolID.equals("PBS_ELLIPSE----") || symbolID.equals("PBS_RECTANGLE--"))
3406                {
3407                    if (AM != null && AM.size() > 1 && coordCount > 0)
3408                    {
3409                        return "true";
3410                    }
3411                    else
3412                    {
3413                        return ("false: " + symbolID + ", requires 2 AM values, length and width (AM) and 1 control point");
3414                    }
3415                }
3416                                else
3417                                {
3418                                        return ("false: " + symbolID + ", not a recognized code for a parametered basic shape.");
3419                                }
3420            }
3421                        else {
3422                return ("symbolID: \"" + symbolID + "\" not recognized.");
3423            }
3424
3425            //now check for required modifiers\
3426            ArrayList<Double> AM = symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE);
3427            ArrayList<Double> AN = symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AN_AZIMUTH);
3428            String result = hasRequiredModifiers(symbolID, dc, AM, AN);
3429
3430            if (result.equals("true") == false) {
3431                return result;
3432            } else {
3433                return "true";
3434            }
3435        } catch (Exception exc) {
3436            ErrorLogger.LogException("MultiPointHandler", "canRenderMultiPoint", exc);
3437            return "true";
3438        }
3439    }
3440    static private String AddImageFillToKML(ArrayList<POINT2> tgPoints,
3441            String jsonContent, SparseArray symbolModifiers, IPointConversion ipc, Boolean normalize)  //symbolModifiers was MilStdSymbol mSymbol
3442    {
3443        if(tgPoints==null || tgPoints.size()==0)
3444            return null;
3445        //get original point values in pixel form                    
3446        ArrayList<Point2D> pixelPoints = new ArrayList<Point2D>();
3447        //Path2D path = new Path2D.Double();
3448        GeneralPath path = new GeneralPath();
3449
3450        //for(JavaLineArray.POINT2 pt : tgPoints)
3451        int kcount = tgPoints.size();
3452        POINT2 tpTemp = null;
3453        for(int k = 0; k < kcount;k++)
3454        {
3455            tpTemp = tgPoints.get(k);
3456            pixelPoints.add(new Point2D.Double(tpTemp.x, tpTemp.y));
3457            if(k>0)
3458            {
3459                path.lineTo(tpTemp.x, tpTemp.y);
3460            }
3461            else
3462            {
3463                path.moveTo(tpTemp.x, tpTemp.y);
3464            }
3465        }
3466        Rectangle rect = path.getBounds();
3467        //get url for the fill or line pattern PNG
3468        //String goImageUrl = SECWebRenderer.GenerateSymbolLineFillUrl(mSymbol.getModifierMap(), pixelPoints,rect);
3469        String goImageUrl = SECWebRenderer.GenerateSymbolLineFillUrl(symbolModifiers, pixelPoints,rect);
3470        //generate the extra KML needed to insert the image
3471        String goKML = GenerateGroundOverlayKML(goImageUrl,ipc,rect,normalize);
3472        goKML += "</Folder>";
3473
3474        //StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
3475        //sb.replace(start, end, str)
3476        jsonContent = jsonContent.replace("</Folder>", goKML);
3477        
3478        return jsonContent;
3479    }

3481    static private String hasRequiredModifiers(String symbolID, int dc, ArrayList<Double> AM, ArrayList<Double> AN) {
3482
3483        String message = symbolID;
3484        try {
3485            if ((dc >= 16 && dc <= 20)) {
3486                if (dc == SymbolDef.DRAW_CATEGORY_CIRCULAR_PARAMETERED_AUTOSHAPE)//16
3487                {
3488                    if (AM != null && AM.size() > 0) {
3489                        return "true";
3490                    } else {
3491                        message += " requires a modifiers object that has 1 distance/AM value.";
3492                        return message;
3493                    }
3494                } else if (dc == SymbolDef.DRAW_CATEGORY_RECTANGULAR_PARAMETERED_AUTOSHAPE)//17
3495                {
3496                    if (AM != null && AM.size() >= 2
3497                            && AN != null && AN.size() >= 1) {
3498                        return "true";
3499                    } else {
3500                        message += (" requires a modifiers object that has 2 distance/AM values and 1 azimuth/AN value.");
3501                        return message;
3502                    }
3503                } else if (dc == SymbolDef.DRAW_CATEGORY_SECTOR_PARAMETERED_AUTOSHAPE)//18
3504                {
3505                    if (AM != null && AM.size() >= 2
3506                            && AN != null && AN.size() >= 2) {
3507                        return "true";
3508                    } else {
3509                        message += (" requires a modifiers object that has 2 distance/AM values and 2 azimuth/AN values per sector.  The first sector can have just one AM value although it is recommended to always use 2 values for each sector.");
3510                        return message;
3511                    }
3512                } else if (dc == SymbolDef.DRAW_CATEGORY_CIRCULAR_RANGEFAN_AUTOSHAPE)//19
3513                {
3514                    if (AM != null && AM.size() > 0) {
3515                        return "true";
3516                    } else {
3517                        message += (" requires a modifiers object that has at least 1 distance/AM value");
3518                        return message;
3519                    }
3520                } else if (dc == SymbolDef.DRAW_CATEGORY_TWO_POINT_RECT_PARAMETERED_AUTOSHAPE)//20
3521                {
3522                    if (AM != null && AM.size() > 0) {
3523                        return "true";
3524                    } else {
3525                        message += (" requires a modifiers object that has 1 distance/AM value.");
3526                        return message;
3527                    }
3528                } else {
3529                    //should never get here
3530                    return "true";
3531                }
3532            } else {
3533                //no required parameters
3534                return "true";
3535            }
3536        } catch (Exception exc) {
3537            ErrorLogger.LogException("MultiPointHandler", "hasRequiredModifiers", exc);
3538            return "true";
3539        }
3540    }
